**Abstract:** Renewable energy is important for achieving carbon neutrality goal. With the great success of Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT in automatic content generation, LLMs are playing an increasingly important role. However, there has not been a specially designed LLM for renewable energy. Meanwhile, there has not been any dataset of renewable energy for training LLMs. Therefore, this paper published the first open-source Renewable Energy Academic Paper (REAP) dataset for non-commercial LLM research of renewable energy. REAP dataset is collected through searching the title and abstract of 1,168,970 academic literatures from Web of Science. Based on REAP dataset, HouYi (“ 后羿 ” in Chinese) model, the first LLM for renewable energy, is developed through finetuning general LLMs. HouYi demonstrated powerful academic paper paragraph generation ability in renewable energy field. Experiments show that its ability to generate academic papers on renewable energy is comparable to ChatGPT, slightly outperforms Claude, ERNIE Bot and SparkDesk, and significantly outperforms open-source LLaMA-13B model.

## **1. Introduction** 

Nowadays, the overuse of fossil fuels has caused serious environmental problems, such as global warming and sea level rising[1-3]. Developing renewable energy, such as wind energy and solar energy, is one of the most effective methods to solve the environmental problems[ 4 , 5 ]. With the proposal of carbon neutrality goal, the development of renewable energy is accelerating. Developing renewable energy is currently one of the most important for solving environmental problems and achieving carbon neutrality goal, and thus renewable energy is becoming one of the most important academic research fields [6]. 

In the era of Artificial Intelligence (AI), many researchers have introduced AI algorithms into renewable energy field [7,8]. Many AI techniques, such as deep neural networks, support vector machines, gradient boosting decision trees etc., have been successfully used to forecast the future wind power and photovoltaic power generation [9]. AI techniques like deep neural networks., have also been successfully used in the Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) of renewable energy systems [10 ]. AI techniques like deep reinforcement learning, have made great success in operational optimization of renewable energy systems [11]. With the large-scale renewable energy in the electricity grid, AI has also been successfully used in the trade of electricity markets[12 ]. Therefore, AI has been playing an increasingly important role in the development of renewable energy.

As the recent breakthrough and the state-of-the-art technique in AI field, ChatGPT (Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer) [13 ] is a Large Language Model (LLM) 

2 

trained on billions of text data from websites [14,15]. ChatGPT is capable of generating human-like text, answer questions like human, and complete various language-related tasks with high accuracy [16]. Since its launch by OpenAI company in November 2022, it has quickly become one of the fastest-growing consumer applications in history, with millions of active users monthly. Its vast knowledge base and language processing capabilities have revolutionized the way people interact with technology [17], making it easier and more natural to communicate with machines [18 ]. ChatGPT has been successfully used in various fields, including business, education, manufacturing, healthcare, medicine, and communication. Through ChatGPT, renewable energy researchers can automatically generate some academic paper paragraphs, and improve the academic writing efficiency.

The boom of ChatGPT brings the popularity of Large Language Models (LLMs). To compete with ChatGPT developed by OpenAI, many companies like Google company, Baidu company, Anthropic company, iFLYTEK company etc., are publishing their own LLMs. These new LLMs include Claude model [19] developed by Anthropic company, ERNIE Bot model [20-22] developed by Baidu company, SparkDesk model [23 ] developed by iFLYTEK company etc. These LLMs can be comparative to ChatGPT in some aspects. Through these LLMs, renewable energy researchers can also generate some useful academic paper paragraphs, and combines the text generated by ChatGPT to further improve the academic writing efficiency.

Although above LLMs have various merits, they are non-open source models. Users can only use them through their official websites. Additionally, above LLMs are not specially designed to satisfy the need for a certain field. When above general LLMs are applied to a certain field, they cannot give the optimal replies due to the lack of accurate and domain-specific expert knowledge [24]. One possible solution to this issue 

3 

is finetuning the open-source LLMs for a specific field to introduce the domain knowledge to LLMs. LLaMA and GLM (General Language Model) are two popular open-source general LLMs. Touvron et al. [25] proposed open-source LLaMA model, and demonstrated the superiorities over conventional open-source LLMs. Du et al. [26] proposed open-source GLM models and demonstrated good performance. Researchers have finetuned open-source general LLMs for various specific fields. In the field of medicine, there are DoctorGLM [27] open-source model, HuatuoGPT [28]open-source model, Bian Que [29] open-source model etc. In the field of law, there are LawGPT[30] open-source model and Lawyer LLaMA[31] open-source model. In the field of finance, Cornucopia-LLaMA-Fin-Chinese [32] is a good attempt to finetune LLaMA.

All above LLMs for specific domains have achieved better performance than general LLMs in the target domain. However, in the field of renewable energy and carbon neutrality, there has not been any open-source LLMs for this specific domain. Additionally, there has not been any open-source datasets related to renewable energy for training LLMs. The lacking of open-source datasets and domain-specific LLMs greatly restricts the applications of LLMs in renewable energy field. These are the problems this paper deals with. 

To address these problems, this paper published the first open-source Renewable Energy Academic Paper (REAP) dataset for non-commercial LLM research of renewable energy, which contains the title and abstract of 1,168,970 academic papers in Web of Science. Based on REAP dataset, HouYi (“后羿” in Chinese) model, the first LLM for renewable energy, is developed through finetuning general LLM models. The proposed HouYi model demonstrated better performance than general LLMs in renewable energy field. 

**The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:** 

4 

Firstly, this paper published the first open-source dataset called Renewable Energy Academic Paper (REAP) dataset with the title and abstract of 1,168,970 academic papers for training LLMs on renewable energy field. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that the open-source dataset for training LLMs in renewable energy field has been proposed.

Secondly, HouYi (“后羿” in Chinese) model, the first LLM for renewable energy field is developed through finetuning general LLMs. A public web demo for HouYi model of renewable energy field is published, which is available to all readers. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first open-source LLM that specially designed for renewable energy fields. 

Thirdly, this paper introduces human experts-based analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method evaluate LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that AHP method has been used for evaluating LLMs. Experiments verify that HouYi model has excellent abilities in paper generation of renewable energy field. 

The rest of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 constructs the REAP dataset for renewable energy. Section 3 gives the methods and procedure for building HouYi model. Section 4 performs academic paper generation experiments and evaluates its performance. Section 5 concludes the paper and outlines the future research orientation.

estimation into the power curve modelling process, more reliable predictions of wind turbine performance can be obtained,

## **5. Conclusion and future work** 

Developing renewable energy is important for protecting environment and realizing carbon neutrality goal. With the great success of Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, LLMs are revolutionizing people’s life and helping researchers 

30 

with academic writing. However, current LLMs are mostly general LLMs and are not designed for a specific domain. When applying to a specific domain, general LLMs cannot obtain the optimal performance. Currently, there has not been a specially designed LLM for renewable energy. Meanwhile, there has not been any dataset of renewable energy for training LLMs. 

To address these problems, this paper published the first open-source Renewable Energy Academic Paper (REAP) dataset for non-commercial LLM research of renewable energy. REAP dataset contains 1,168,970 academic literatures from Web of Science, with the title and abstract being the input and output respectively. Based on REAP dataset, HouYi (“后羿” in Chinese) model, the first LLM for renewable energy, is developed through finetuning general LLMs. This paper used two methods to evaluate LLMs. The first one is ChatGPT’s automatic evaluation and the second one is the human experts-based Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) method. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that AHP has been used in LLM evaluation.

Experiments show that HouYi demonstrated powerful academic paper paragraph generation ability in renewable energy field. HouYi obtains the highest score in wind and solar energy paper generation. Its ability to generate academic papers on renewable energy is comparable to ChatGPT, slightly outperforms Claude, ERNIE Bot and SparkDesk, and significantly outperforms open-source LLaMA-13B model. The web demo is available at <u>https://renewableenergyllm.cpolar.cn/.The code and dataset are</u> available at <u>https://github.com/mingliangbai/HouYi</u> and will be public immediately after acceptance.
